description: Windows utility for customizable mouse cursor highlights, click animations, spotlight effects, and click sounds.
pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\MFXG-$version.exe")) { throw "Expected release executable MFXG-$version.exe was not found." }; Rename-Item -LiteralPath "$dir\MFXG-$version.exe" -NewName "MouseFXGenerator.exe"
notes: The upstream Windows release is a standalone PyInstaller executable, not a setup installer. The manifest renames it to MouseFXGenerator.exe for a stable shortcut name.
AutoHotkey v2 is required to run the generated mouse-effects engine. The cursor animator feature also requires .NET Framework 4.0 or later.

Application profiles and sounds are stored under %APPDATA%\MouseFX Generator; app settings are stored in the Windows registry via QSettings; the generated script is saved to Documents\mousefx_engine.ahk and animator build files may be saved to Documents\MouseFX_Build. This manifest does not relocate these data to D:.
